proved_results: [P] Reduction: miss <=> (sum_S x)^2 > rho n sum_S x^2, rho=g/(1+g) (checked vs raw interval on all samples, 3 (G,n), 0 discrepancies); P(miss) non-increasing in c, c(kappa0) non-decreasing in kappa0; c_L = max over explicit populations of c_pop (exact quantile of t_S=A^2/(nQ)) is a valid lower bound. [P] K(kappa0) is empty for kappa0<1/G (0.25*frontier is empty for (24,8) and (51,8)). [P] Lemma 1 (generalized) holds with the stated constant: m same-sign values in [a,Ra], k=G-m => kappa >= m/(k(m+R^2 k)) (proof: B>=Sigma/k>=ma/k, T<=mR^2a^2+kB^2; 3000 random checks, 0 violations). [P] Lemma 2: for delta=(n-1)/(c sqrt(1-f))<1 a missed sample is a one-signed band with max/min<(1+delta)/(1-delta) (needs c>8.6/15.6/7.6/18.1 for the four (G,n)). [P] Theorem B (block-counting certificate, integer DP) and Theorem Q (quadratic majorant: 1[miss]<=(1+a1 A^2+a2 Q)^2 for a1>=0, a1+a2/n>=0, a1+a2/(rho n)>=0; exact SRSWOR moment expansion in power sums, involves only p4 so P(miss)<=max over p4 in {1/G,kappa0}); moment formulas verified against full enumeration; Theorem Q certificates re-evaluated in exact rational arithmetic (3 cells). [P] Theorem S: analogous Cantelli-type certificate for the stratified box class. NOT obtained: a bound exact as c->infinity (both certificates plateau above beta=pi(k_min)); no certificate at kappa0>=0.75 frontier except Theorem B with c in the hundreds, and none for (51,8),(51,16) at 0.75.
cU_method: c_U = min of two certificates. (Q) Theorem Q: minimise over (a1,a2) the exact quantity max_{p4 in {1/G,kappa0}} E(1+a1 A^2+a2 Q)^2, bisect on c, then re-verify with rational a1,a2,c (Fractions). Works only for kappa0 <~0.4-0.5*frontier (plateau of the bound at c=inf is 0.04-0.25). (B) Theorem B: tight-band lemma + Lemma 1 window-size cap M + block DP over block sizes (windows of s+1 blocks, s in {1,2}), valid only for c>(n-1)/sqrt(1-f); loose (40-270). Gap to c_L is ~1.5-2x where Q works and 15-100x elsewhere; moment majorants of higher degree were tested optimistically (per-population optimum) and cannot close it; a Chernoff/Hoeffding-with-replacement bound with moment-LP dual was useless (>0.66). c_L method: stochastic search (annealing) over d-valued populations d=2..6 with exact enumeration of count vectors; G=24 best populations re-checked by full enumeration of all C(24,n) samples (identical). Small-G (G=10,n=4) differential-evolution over all 10 values matched grouped search to <=0.7%.
stratified_part: Theorem S gives P(miss)<=min_{a1>=0,a2>=-a1 c^2}[1+2(a1+a2)+3a1^2+2a1a2+a2^2+v0*max(0,max_s Sum-coef)], using exact within-stratum moment ratios (verified vs enumeration). Result: NO certified c at the four requested settings: bound plateau at c=inf is 0.287 (G=51,m=5), 0.167 (G=51,m=10), 0.260 (G=24,m=10), 0.148 (G=24,m=20) > 0.1. The obstruction is the atom P(SE=0): with p=1/(1+Lambda0^2) and K=1/v0=40 strata, P(all strata constant)=0.0858 (m=5), within 14% of alpha. Lower estimates c_L (identical two-point strata, minority fraction scanned, K scanned; exact multinomial enumeration cross-check for one case, otherwise 3e6-draw MC x2 seeds): G=51,m=5: 2.843 (K=42, p=0.0183); G=51,m=10: 2.296 (K=43, p=0.0122); G=24,m=10: 2.607 (K=12, p=0.03); G=24,m=20: 2.089 (K=12, p=0.0275). Certified c exists for milder classes: e.g. Lambda0=9,m=5: v0=0.005 -> 3.03, v0=0.002 -> 2.46; m=10: v0=0.01 -> 3.02; Lambda0=6,G=24,m=10: v0=0.02 -> 2.85; m=20: v0=0.05 -> 3.22; at stated v0 the largest certifiable Lambda0 is 4.77/6.72/3.45/4.83 (c~20-28). Double-precision optimisation, not exact-rational re-verified.
conjectures: (1) Worst case in K(kappa0) has <=3 distinct values at G=24 (d=3 equals d=6 within 0.5%), 4-6 at G=51; small-G global DE found a 5-valued optimum 0.7% above the d<=5 search, so c_L may be ~1% low. (2) For kappa0 <= ~0.75*frontier the maximiser is two-point (k=9 at (24,8), c=sqrt(6)) or a near-two-point perturbation; at >=0.9*frontier a spike group (3-5 units at +-1.8-2.9 SD, rest near 0) dominates and c jumps (2.4->4.5->6.5 at 0.75/0.9/0.95 for (24,8)). (3) True c(kappa0) is within a few percent of c_L for kappa0<=0.5*frontier. (4) Stratified: worst box design = identical two-point strata, minority fraction 0.012-0.03, K just above 1/v0; c_L 2.1-2.8, so an atom-aware argument should certify c near 3.
deviations: Requested kappa0=0.25*frontier is an EMPTY class for (24,8) and (51,8) (kappa0<1/G): no c_L/c_U exist; reported 0.4*frontier instead (plus extra fractions 0.9 for all cells).

c_U is NOT tight: certified only by the quadratic majorant at <=0.4-0.5*frontier; elsewhere only a loose block certificate (c 40-270) or none (no certificate up to 400*(n-1)/sqrt(1-f)) at (24,8,0.9), (51,8,0.75/0.9), (51,16,0.75/0.9).

c_L values are best found by stochastic search over d-valued populations (d<=6) and are provisional; ungrouped full-enumeration local search was run only for G=24 (limited steps, 3 seeds) and did not beat grouped; no ungrouped search for G=51.

Stratified part: no certified c at the 4 requested settings; c_L uses only identical two-point strata (a family), MC-based except one exact cross-check; stratified certificates not re-verified in exact rational arithmetic.
A bound exact as c->infinity was not obtained; Theorem B's DP only constrains windows of <=2-3 blocks. Did not run degree-8 (SOS/SDP) majorants; only tested optimistically per population.
No literature search (as instructed); CLAUDE.md of the repository was not read since the task was self-contained.
